title: A Python's Heart Grows 40 Percent in Two Days After a Big Meal

scenes.text: A python's heart grows forty percent in just two days.
Burmese pythons eat rarely, but when they do, they swallow giant meals.
Within forty-eight hours of feeding, their heart muscle swells by about forty percent.
Scientists call it the fastest heart growth ever measured.
After about two weeks of digestion, the meal is gone and the heart shrinks back.
A heart that grows on demand, then shrinks back.

description:
A Burmese python's heart muscle grows by about 40 percent within 48 hours of a big meal.
Scientists describe it as the fastest heart growth ever measured, and it reverses once the meal is digested.
What animal superpower would you want?
first_comment: Would you want a heart that grows on demand?
